The Premise

The body is one system. We treat it that way.

A blend of sports and functional medicine — macro and micro, Eastern and Western. We resolve the root causes of pain and dysfunction, not mask them. One physician, one integrated plan.

02

What We Target

Four forces decide the length of a life.

  • IAtherosclerosisThe slow narrowing of the arteries — detected and reversed long before it speaks.
  • IIMetabolic diseaseVisceral fat drives insulin resistance and cardiovascular risk — and responds to intervention.
  • IIICancerSurveillance and a body kept in its lowest-inflammation state — the conditions cancer least prefers.
  • IVCognitive declineProtected through metabolism, circulation, and movement — decades upstream of symptoms.
